title: SDLC Quality Threshold Rules
description: Canonical release-blocking quality thresholds for Evolith satellites. These thresholds apply to all SDLC phases where construction or validation occurs.

waiverPolicy.description: A waiver may be used only when the organization deliberately accepts a temporary deviation.

exceptions.cves: High/Critical security vulnerabilities cannot be waived in production releases without explicit Executive Risk Acceptance
exceptions.coverage: Business logic coverage below 80% cannot be waived without Architecture Board approval and remediation plan

rules.title: Code Coverage
rules.description: Coverage below 80% on business logic BLOCKS merge (Phase 3) and RC stamp (Phase 4).

rules.title: Cyclomatic Complexity
rules.description: Methods or functions exceeding cyclomatic complexity of 15 BLOCK merge or RC stamp without refactoring plan or explicit waiver.

rules.title: Security Vulnerabilities
rules.description: Any High or Critical CVE BLOCKS merge, RC stamp, and production release. Medium CVEs require justification.

rules.title: Technical Debt Ratio
rules.description: Technical debt ratio > 5% BLOCKS RC stamp unless a remediation plan with explicit timeline and owner is approved.

rules.title: Testing Pyramid Distribution
rules.description: Release with materially skewed distribution (e.g., 40% unit / 50% integration) requires written explanation. Not a hard block but must be reviewed.

rules.title: Documentation Delta
rules.description: Code changes that alter behavior, introduce new API endpoints, change architecture, or modify operations without corresponding documentation BLOCK merge and Production Live.

rules.title: Observability Evidence
rules.description: Any production API path without traces, structured logs, or metrics BLOCKS Production Live declaration.

rules.title: API Contract Compatibility
rules.description: Breaking changes to inter-module (gRPC/REST) contracts BLOCK merge. Consumer-driven contract tests must pass.
